idea-plugin.name: Session Successor
idea-plugin.description:
Companion to the session-successor Claude Code plugin. When a Claude Code session hands off to its successor, this plugin opens a new terminal tab in the matching project window and runs claude attach <successor> in it, with no action from you. It watches ~/.claude/session-successor/inbox; a note carries only a session name, never a command.

Requires the Claude Code CLI with the session-successor plugin. One command adds its marketplace and installs it:
claude plugin install session-successor --marketplace MelkiorS/claude-plugins
